body:
You can see in the test that [we mocked the JavaScript client](https://github.com/algolia/instantsearch.js/blob/5f41fc6ae8d03c9ddd76dff5e54e73fecc395900/src/lib/__tests__/InstantSearch-test.js#L148-L154), with only a `search` method for now.

The official JavaScript client also exposes an `addAlgoliaAgent` method. You can therefore add this method to the client to mock the `addAlgoliaAgent` function with [`jest.fn()`](https://jestjs.io/docs/en/jest-object#jestfnimplementation). Then, you're able to check that it has been called correctly at instantiation.

Let me know if you need further help.
